title: Robert (War Expert) Pape: Is World War 3 About To Begin?
summary: A political scientist argues the 2026 US-Iran war has trapped the US in escalation, handed Iran control of Hormuz, and may lead Iran to a bomb, while a world war in the next months is unlikely.

assertions.quote: I don't think World War is coming in the next 6 months.

verdicts.note: Forecasters put the chance of a direct great-power war in any half-year in the low single digits even amid the current wars.
Metaculus puts a world war at 22% over 2019-2050 (about 1% a year on average), so one within six months is very unlikely.
Clauset's constant-hazard estimate (about 43% per century for a WWII-sized war) implies well under 1% in any six-month window.
Braumoeller's estimate of about 13% per century for a war killing over 1% of humanity implies a very small chance in any six months.
Metaculus forecasters put World War III before 2050 at 22% (3.3k forecasters), implying well under 1% for any six-month window.

assertions.quote: I think the odds of World War go up if we use if America uses a nuclear weapon in Iran.
It's the most powerful opponent America has faced since Nazi Germany in World War II.

verdicts.note: The US fought China directly in the Korean War, a far larger military, and Iran's economy and conventional forces are much smaller than a great power's.

assertions.quote: Iran shut down the Strait of Hormuz. Iran decides who goes through the Strait of Hormuz.
it will expand like a set of concentric circles until Iran becomes the fourth center of world power.

verdicts.note: Iran's economy is a small fraction of the US, Chinese or Indian economy and transit leverage does not create industrial or military power on that scale.

assertions.quote: we have extremely expensive weapons because we're modeling the war that we fought in 1991, the first Gulf War.

verdicts.note: Analysts widely warn of thin munitions stocks and vulnerable large ships against cheap drones and missiles, but US precision forces remain highly effective in many missions.

CSIS finds large surface ships extremely vulnerable, hypersonics a costly niche and recommends cheaper fighters, but costly bombers, submarines and long-range missiles were what defeated the invasion.

assertions.quote: They have the centrifuge technology on their soil.
I think there's a substantial chance they're going to get a nuclear weapon, greater than 50/50, over the next year.

verdicts.note: Covert enrichment and weaponisation under intense surveillance and strikes is hard, and pre-war forecasts put an Iranian test within a year well under even odds.
Polymarket priced an Iranian nuclear test before 2027 at 4%, which weighs against Iran being more likely than not to have a weapon within a year.
FRI's 2024 experts and superforecasters gave Iran 25% and 30% chances of acquiring nuclear weapons by 2030, so not more likely than not within a year.

assertions.quote: everybody now knows America can be beaten.

verdicts.note: Allied perceptions of US power after the 2026 war are not yet measured in any systematic way.
